title: Benchmark expansion and verifier isolation
objective: Extend the formalization benchmark while keeping theorem data, executable proofs, negative checks and acceptance evidence independently verifiable.

in_scope: M3 benchmark expansion, independent verifier surfaces, replay evidence

deliverables.name: Expanded benchmark slice
deliverables.acceptance: Add a versioned M3 manifest and Lean declarations with explicit negative checks.

deliverables.name: Independent verifier
deliverables.acceptance: Validate M3 metadata and source lineage without importing theorem policy from executable proof code.

deliverables.name: Negative replay corpus
deliverables.acceptance: Reject altered manifests, proof sources and negative checks in temporary fixtures.

deliverables.name: Cross-phase evidence binding
deliverables.acceptance: Bind M3 evidence to the M2 readiness report and locked toolchain.

deliverables.name: M3 readiness gate
deliverables.acceptance: Produce a machine-checkable readiness report before further benchmark growth.
